type.description: Enumeration that indicates if the endpoint is of type `DEVICE` or `APPLICATION`.

name.description: The `name` field in the response is calculated using device tag. Admins have the ability to set tags for devices. If a `name=<value>` tag is set, for example “name=home phone“, then the `<value>` is included in the `name` field of the API response. In this example “home phone”.
